run_relicense_script: run the relicensing script on a directory to replace LGPL3 headers with MPL2 headers
update_license_header: update a file's text by replacing the LGPL3 license header with the MPL2 license header
review_exclusions_set: review the exclusions set to add or remove filenames from the relicensing process
refactor_update_function: refactor the update function to support additional license header replacements beyond LGPL3 to MPL2
summarize_relicense_script: summarize the relicensing script that walks a directory tree and replaces license headers in source files
